draft_en.subject: A value tier under Moxa for OT projects - DIN-rail managed PoE
draft_en.body:
Hello Neteon team,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "24 Port PoE Managed Switch" on 8 September 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the OT networking projects where a Moxa switch is over budget, we supply a value tier that fits the same cabinet:

- DIN-rail 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2 managed (VLAN, QoS, IGMP), Marvell-based, -40 to 75 C, model STI-288GPM - $78.9 USD EXW at distributor price (MOQ 1, 15-day validity)
- DIN-rail 8 x Gigabit + 2 x SFP, unmanaged, model STI-280GE - $46.6 USD EXW

FCC/CE/RoHS, 3-year warranty together with our DIN power supply; serial device servers we do not make.

One question: would one bench unit at the unit price help you position a value tier for your dealers?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
